## Introduction

This document provides a short summary of the TikTok video views dataset.

## Load the data

```{r}
video_views <- read.csv("../data/raw/video_view.csv")
```

## Preview of the dataset

```{r}
head(video_views)
```

## Summary statistics

```{r}
summary(video_views)
```

## Dataset dimensions

```{r}
cat("Number of rows:", nrow(video_views), "\n")
cat("Number of columns:", ncol(video_views))
```

## Missing values

```{r}
colSums(is.na(video_views))
```
## Variable names

```{r}
names(video_views)
```

## Impressions and watch rate

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(video_views, aes(x = impressions_n, y = watch_rate)) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Relationship between Impressions and Watch Rate",
    x = "Number of Impressions",
    y = "Watch Rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
